If you have a device that supports OTG, this tiny adapter is for you. There are a myriad of ways it may come in handy; use your phone as a battery bank for another device, use a USB keyboard with your tablet, play movies off of a flash drive or external HDD, you name it. As for this model in particular, I have had no issues whatsoever. It is rigid and a snug fit on both sides. No issues taking out of the USB cable either. I'm glad to have this in my gadget kit.

Works terrifically - hooked up a USB camera to an old Android device I had laying around, and it worked immediately (via CameraFi). But it's a little too minimalist; without any kind of protruding edge, it's very difficult to remove from the USB cable once inserted.

Side note: the ultra-minimalist packaging is severely flawed. The first one of these I ordered came without the product; I only received the packaging. Apparently, the product slipped right out of the top. Total fail. Second one arrived intact. Note that 4-star rating is for product only, not packaging.

But if you have a USB item (I use it for a wireless keyboard dongle) you will only be plugging into a micro USB, it is awesome.

It serves the purpose it was designed for, (which is admittedly simple) and nothing more. It gets the job done. I use it on my Lenovo Yoga tablet-2 and it has worked flawlessly. It initially feels like it will break at the drop of a hat, but it has not let me down yet and I am not that careful with it at all.

If it broke, I would immediately buy another one, the price is reasonable and it does what I need when I need it.

An interesting option to adapt a USB device to a Micro USB.  This adapter has a shorter stack height than an OTG adapter.  I suggest putting this a seperate case, because it could get lost in a tablet bag or laptop backpack.

Note 4/Tab S 8.9: After playing around with this for 15 minutes I'm ready to rate it 5 star. Worked with every flash drive/HD keyboard/mouse I plugged into it. Obviously for it to work for you, your device must support USB host over your micro USB port. I copied 2/3s of a full 64gb to a 128gb thumb drive in about 20 minutes with out fail.
